text: 从权威渠道获悉，证监会近日向证券公司发布了2026年分类评价结果，参评主体合计106家，其中44家子公司合并至母公司评价，最终，A类公司53家，B类公司42家，C类公司11家，A类公司中AA级公司14家。
text_en: According to authoritative sources, the CSRC recently released its 2026 classification evaluation results to securities firms. A total of 106 entities participated, with 44 subsidiaries merged into their parent companies for evaluation. Ultimately, there were 53 Class A firms, 42 Class B firms, and 11 Class C firms. Among the Class A firms, 14 were rated AA.
